## Outcome

I reduced scope and prepared the active branches for clear maintainer decisions rather than adding more code to uncertain solutions.

## What I Did

- Kept [PR #306](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/306) limited to removing redundant selector existence checks.
- Avoided mixing new behavior into a cleanup PR.
- Reviewed maintainer feedback on PR #338 and PR #341.
- Prepared to close proposals that were no longer the preferred solution.
- Kept PR #339 separate from CI work because it changed user-visible facet rendering.

## Learnings

A small cleanup is valuable when it removes duplicate conditions without changing behavior. It becomes harder to review when it also tries to solve unrelated features or infrastructure. A closed investigation can remain useful documentation and prevent future contributors from repeating the same root-cause analysis.

## Challenges / Notes

Progress during review can look quieter than implementation work. The useful output was a smaller mergeable branch, explicit closure criteria, and a clearer boundary around the feature work.

## Next Week Targets

Merge the selector cleanup, close or rehome the two CI proposals, and keep the facet-strip feature current.
